title: Make Lexicographically Smallest Array by Swapping Elements
goal: Produce the lexicographically smallest array using swaps of values differing by at most limit.
strategy: Sort value-index pairs. Consecutive values separated by at most limit form a swappable component through a chain; larger gaps split components. Assign each component sorted values to its sorted original indices.
